title: Every hikers best friend!
content:
I don’t know how I ever went walking without AllTrails. 
It gives you choices of new and interesting routes, near your current location. Or you can search in advance for places you want to visit. You can even plan your own routes using a variety of map layers, ensuring you use marked paths. 
Once you get going, you can track your progress and it will even notify you if you are going off course. 
A brilliant app, it has changed my life!
author: 49 to 50

title: Great but missing one feature
content: I love this app but I use it for running and have to get my phone out. The Apple watch element of the app is not particularly useful for navigation. It could really use a follow along map graphic like on the phone. The Apple Watch is capable of it through apps like workoutdoors so I don't know why it doesn't have it. Would love to see it added. Even if it was added to the subscription service, I would buy it straight away.
author: Mcdon.con

title: Does the job, but there’s room for improvement.
content:
The map function is great and I love having a space just to record my hikes. Two suggestions:

- I paid for an annual membership just so I could get my downloaded map on my watch. The need to constantly pull my phone out to check my location was very inconvenient. Very disappointed. 
- it would be great if at a certain zoom I could start seeing the trails get highlighted on a map (the way physical maps and ski maps do, with trails marked in different colours etc), and when I select that trail I could see the suggested hikes associated with it. Selecting a pin with 12 hikes, each small variations of each other, and not having an easy way to compare the difference between them is very clunky. 

Thank you and I hope the app will get better! I love hiking and would love to support a community designed for hikers 😊
author: ColSpargel

title: Not very user friendly
content:
I have had this app for a long time and used it very often. But it looks like every update makes it worse and worse for users. First of all, if I send a link through whatsapp it doesn’t open it via the app but through the browser.

Secondly, you can’t send the gpx file to your garmin device. You could do it through safari not long ago, but now if you try to do it, it opens the app and there is no option to send the route to the garmin. Or if it’s there it’s well hidden. This is one of the features I would use a lot and one of the reasons why I use other similar apps instead.
author: tomaskerak

title: You can’t plan a route
content:
AllTrails does not allow you draw your own route on the map, save it and then follow it. On the web version this is possible so why not in the app? On the web version you can upload gpx routes, why not on the app? Overall very frustrating! 

Being able to follow a map on Apple Watch is good but after an hour, the watch app starts going very slow and struggles to load the map. The watch app also doesn’t show heart rate or allow you to see your splits for each kilometre completed mid activity. 

Overall, a lot of potential but All trails need to add gpx uploads and route creating functions to the app. Most of these features are standard in strava and OSMaps.
author: Irritating!!!!!!!

title: A Must-Have App!
content:
Cannot recommend this app enough! 

I have 3 dogs and we’re forever getting bored of our usual stomping grounds, but with AllTrails, we’re able to find new locations.

The app gives details of popular routes, directions to the start of walks, length of trail, average time it takes, etc. There is the option for people to leave reviews (which some often use to give warning of storm damage, or times to avoid that’s good to know ahead of time).
It even gives details of the weather predictions at the time you intend on going!

Using the “navigate” tab on the app, you’re able to zoom into any location and find nearby trails. It shows you every path that is available.. making it nearly impossible to get lost!

An absolute must-have. It’s an app I use on a weekly basis 🫶🏼
author: Jadey2506

title: A number of issues …
content:
I am a new user having recently paid full price for the year. I have used it twice in the week I started my subscription - but have found a number of quirks/issues that don’t give me confidence in using it going forwards. My main reason for buying it was to help guide me on routes that I’m not familiar with. 

Today I did a 6.25 local hike - to check functionality - that I’ve done many times before. Distance was fine compared to using Apple Watch Workout (Hike) - but the elevation gained was out. It’s a flat route. AW measures it as 18ft - but All Trails said it 161ft. Of more concern - bearing in mind I track all my activity data and need it to be accurate for comparison purposes, it converted to 75 flights climbed. That’s just nonsense. 

Another issue for me is that the app doesn’t display current heart rate. Again, something that’s important to me. 

Another quirk is that when the activity is saved, this morning’s hike shows as ‘Morning hike’ - which I know can be edited to make it personal - but underneath, it has a link to another nearby route that bears no resemblance to the hike I’ve done. Where this was an issue was on the first hike I did. When I’d completed it … I shared it with someone and the text of the route relates to the route in the link - not the route I’ve taken. It’s bizarre. Why does this happen? 

But probably the main issue for me is that it falls down on the main reason I paid for the full version. I am looking to hike the whole of the South Downs Way this year. I’ll be doing this in different stages and I wanted to plan them out in advance. When creating a route, the dotted lines on the map for the various trails don’t actually have the trail name. So you have no idea which dotted line is the SDW as there as so many other footpath options. It’s very poor. 

Unless the developer can help me out with these issues, I can’t see me using the app going forwards and really think a refund is due as the app isn’t fit for purpose.

title: Well worth it for the humble rambler

Easy to find a route for you, save those you enjoy and of course, navigate trails wherever you go. Only improvement I could think of would be suggested ETAs based on walking speed etc.

title: Review
content:

Speed of app when searching for routes etc.  it really is painfully slow. 

When navigating, default the colour of the recorded route to blue so it’s different from the line you’re actually following. This would be particularly useful after going wrong and retracing steps - can get confusing with a mass of red lines. 

When viewing the map you can see the actual direction, but not when actually navigating. Let us, by default, see the actual direction when navigating. 

Let us reverse the direction of any route with a single button. 

Following on from letting us see the actual direction when navigating, give some means of making that really clear when doing a large route that crosses over itself many times and where you walk back the way you came for many small stretches.

I am a new user having recently paid full price for the year. I have used it twice in the week I started my subscription - but have found a number of quirks/issues that don’t give me confidence in using it going forwards. My main reason for buying it was to help guide me on routes that I’m not familiar with. 

Today I did a 6.25 local hike - to check functionality - that I’ve done many times before. Distance was fine compared to using Apple Watch Workout (Hike) - but the elevation gained was out. It’s a flat route. AW measures it as 18ft - but All Trails said it 161ft. Of more concern - bearing in mind I track all my activity data and need it to be accurate for comparison purposes, it converted to 75 flights climbed. That’s just nonsense. 

Another issue for me is that the app doesn’t display current heart rate. Again, something that’s important to me. 

Another quirk is that when the activity is saved, this morning’s hike shows as ‘Morning hike’ - which I know can be edited to make it personal - but underneath, it has a link to another nearby route that bears no resemblance to the hike I’ve done. Where this was an issue was on the first hike I did. When I’d completed it … I shared it with someone and the text of the route relates to the route in the link - not the route I’ve taken. It’s bizarre. Why does this happen? 

But probably the main issue for me is that it falls down on the main reason I paid for the full version. I am looking to hike the whole of the South Downs Way this year. I’ll be doing this in different stages and I wanted to plan them out in advance. When creating a route, the dotted lines on the map for the various trails don’t actually have the trail name. So you have no idea which dotted line is the SDW as there as so many other footpath options. It’s very poor. 

Unless the developer can help me out with these issues, I can’t see me using the app going forwards and really think a refund is due as the app isn’t fit for purpose.
author: HeavySoul

title: Well worth it for the humble rambler
content:
Had the app for free for a few years and have always liked it. Paid for the annual subscription more recently and the add ons (maps offline, wrong turn alerts, weather overlays etc) are also well worth it. 

Easy to find a route for you, save those you enjoy and of course, navigate trails wherever you go. Only improvement I could think of would be suggested ETAs based on walking speed etc.
author: <-Jack->

title: Very poor app, not worth the money, greedy developers
content:
Update: for those they won’t refund (consumer regulations and the cool off period don’t matter to these people): unsubscribe and ask your bank to reclaim the money. That is the only way to have them operate like an honest company.  

There’s nothing on this app that you can’t get for free online. The interface is poor, unintuitive, and a pain to use. Do not waste your money on this tosh.

Be aware that they have made it difficult to cancel your account through the app and will not consider refunding you if you weren’t able to cancel before they got their hands on your money. Very greedy, very selfish, and no where near worth the £36 I’ve just wasted.
author: Johnny7625

title: Review
content:
I do love AllTrails. Some improvements could be made:

Speed of app when searching for routes etc.  it really is painfully slow. 

When navigating, default the colour of the recorded route to blue so it’s different from the line you’re actually following. This would be particularly useful after going wrong and retracing steps - can get confusing with a mass of red lines. 

When viewing the map you can see the actual direction, but not when actually navigating. Let us, by default, see the actual direction when navigating. 

Let us reverse the direction of any route with a single button. 

Following on from letting us see the actual direction when navigating, give some means of making that really clear when doing a large route that crosses over itself many times and where you walk back the way you came for many small stretches.
author: Jem Mason

title: If you love hiking, you need this app!
content: It’s just awesome! Trails that I wouldn’t even dream of just listed methodically for the picking. You can see pics posted by other people, read their reviews, know beforehand what the difficulty level is such as easy, moderate or difficult. You can also get directions to the start of the trail as well as navigation whilst on it. It’s my new favourite app and I’ll have it to thank for many an adventure to come. Thank you All Trails ❤️
author: CatyCatherine

title: AllTrails 5🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
content: I came across this app 3 years ago when I wanted to do a walk from a caravan sit. I forgot to cancel it so I ended up paying for it for a year. BEST DECISION EVER, I have used this app everyday for tracking my walks, miles and keeping up to speed. I can go anywhere and find a walk in the local area. It hasn’t been wrong up to now which is great. Three years on and still using this useful app. Totally recommend it for everyone 🙌🏽
author: KellyJmadaboutgiraffes

title: A super easy to follow app.
content:
Love this app. It’s never let me down. Quick to send you a reminder on a planned route that you have taken a wrong turn. 
Been in the Black mountains and it’s kept up when in the middle of nowhere.  Makes you feel secure knowing you can find your bearings if you go wrong. 
Also some fantastic walks listed and the reviews are super helpful to know if it’s dog friendly or easy to walk.
author: Juju & the dog crew

title: Average
content: This app looked good and seemed to show trails that other apps didn’t. Unfortunately I found it useless when I was outside as paths trails are shown in white which becomes invisible when you look at your screen outside. I didn’t find it very user friendly or easy to navigate around the app. I found I never used it as it was so frustrating. It also was annoying how it always showed routes right next to my house… which I’m already very familiar with and dont need an app to tell me about.! No renewals from me I’m afraid.
author: Guthries travels

title: favourite app
content: This is my favourite app by far. I don't use the paid version but I am genuinely considering doing so just to support it and the work that has been put into it. It offers the most accurate positioning in regards to the map, even when off-line which is essential to follow the right track when hiking. it also allows me to keep track of my own hikes. I absolutely love this app. Thank you.
author: lucipelussi

title: Outstanding!!!
content: When it comes to paying for apps, I am always sceptical, but this app is well worth the money. I was indecisive on where to walk my dog and we were always looking for new walks. Picking walks has never been easier thanks to this app, and I haven't picked a bad one yet. It's so easy to use and I've been on some amazing trails with it. It allows you to upload photos and review which is great. I'm in love with it.
author: nicmoo30

title: I love this app!
content: Even as someone who does not record their trips or write reviews on the app, it is still so helpful to find new places to explore and use the reviews and comments of other people to understand what to wear, to go clockwise or anticlockwise, how long it might take, what sort of terrain the route covers, etc etc. I just love it. Looking forward to exploring the new features in the most recent update.
author: grgna

title: Good tech but lacks some of the obvious
content:
It’s a good app for finding new routes and a variety of walks. The interactive trail preview and way finder is great too. 

Feels a bit like the tech has been at the cost of some basic necessities though. Often, the amount of features and tools you don’t really need begin to overwhelm while, meanwhile, it can be hard to quickly find very basic info that’s essential….such as post codes, parking information and advisory notes in relation to obstacles and private property. 

This can be very frustrating.
author: tomjwray77

title: Extremely useful
content: We have used the app in what seemed like the most obscure locations and it has all the trails mapped so well. Love the navigation feature, trail reviews and the whole database of trails we can browse whenever and wherever we want to go out and about. The base version is also so generous that it may be all you need. For that reason we ended up buying the “+” version to support the developers.
author: Kuba24...

title: Annoying search
content:
It’s a good app, of course, but I find searching for trials really annoying. Ultimately I want to be able to input an address and see the closest routes nearby on a map. Instead, I get search returns of specific routes and I have to tap into them to preview then scroll around a map to locate the address. Or, I might get no search returns because no routes are linked to my specific address criteria. Makes using the app really long winded. 

Input address > view all nearby routes > select route
author: Kenny Yucca

title: I love this app
content: I love this app! I use it all the time! It’s an essential for anytime and can show you even small trails and even offline if you already downloaded the map/opened it and it’s at the background. Super duper handy! Thank you for making this accessible for people! Also love the reviews so you can check out what people think and find out about any pitfalls in advance!
author: Tanjaa901990

title: Very good generally
content: I have found this app really useful. However,  what would be really handy is if there was a vibrate option for when you need to make a turning… so you don’t have to constantly have the map live on your screen (big drain on your phone battery) and therefore don’t have to have your eyes on the map the whole time. It vibrates after a bit if you’ve taken a wrong turning,  but it’s a bit hit and miss.
author: Bertiewatt

title: Best App for Outdoor Adventures
content: Amazing app for anyone who loves the outdoors. Great for finding trails near you or in new areas, and perfect if you like going off-trail since it makes it easy to find your way back. Handy for creating your own routes and seeing useful details like distance, elevation, and terrain. Would love a future feature for stargazing on night hikes — but overall, can’t recommend it enough!
author: Ontheroof201517

title: Wow, Wow, Wow
content:
The more I use this app, the more I love it.  I’ve been a keen hiker/walker for years and have tended to just go somewhere and explore. 
But with this app my trips are no longer hit and miss. I can explore places now without being disappointed.
I’ve even discovered trails around my local area (which is in the back and beyond) that are featured here!!
Can’t wait to try this app abroad when I’m travelling further afield again.
Fantastic app, keep up the fabulous work.
author: angieb567

title: Usually 5* but Recent update causing problems..
content:
Been a Pro user for over a year & loved the app, used on many trails without any issues at all.

Recent update caused a few problems on my last hike - main one was app kept closing/crashing. Also location of my GPS didn’t seem too accurate (I was on the trail but according to the map I was way off/vice versa) I’d done the same route a few months prior with no issues also had the maps downloaded so shouldn’t usually be a problem.
author: Baker104

title: AllTrails Maps
content: Get ideas for walks in your local area where you live or places you visit. Get inspired to get out and about. Different routes for every ability and fitness level. Record your route to monitor your exercise and distance or follow someone else’s route. Share with others or simply create your own history. Excellent app which gets better every year.
author: Safari kid

title: Great app
content:
Awesome for finding routes and have done lots of hikes with app

Request for the developers - i’d love to be able to filter routes according to whether they’re accessible by public transport (maybe the start point is close to a train station or bus stop), as i currently have to look at google maps for each route I view to see whether its doable without a car

Thanks!!

Difficulty - It seems the longer walks are often classed as difficult, when in fact the terrain is not. We all know a long walk is harder than a short walk. Difficulty needs to be terrain only.

title: Apple Watch waste of time

I have done 14 km trip around my town. When I finished recording on my iPhone as instructed  , saved track showed me 0.1 km  of 14 km I made( Bluetooth range).14km of tracks around Gillingham is not saved. Long story short this app do not work on Apple Watch without iPhone. So tell me please, What is the purpose of having watch capable of recording all your activity if you still have to run with your phone in the pocket?.

content: If you want to see some trails round a village for example in a rural area of North Yorkshire UK and you type in the village name. AllTrails doesn’t show you on the map where the village is but instead tells you there are 90 trails near there, which is not that helpful. The app works fine if you are in the village and in that case you will see a blue dot indicating your location and you can choose trails near your location. In other words the app is less good for planning prior to arrival
author: labotw

title: Scam - you don't get a free trial!
content:

Cancelled it and then on the 7th day I received an invoice for £35. I contacted All Trails who said to look in my subscriptions and if I had cancelled then to message Apple. title: Free version amazing
content:
I stumbled across this app while hiking in the Welsh mountains. I currently pay for strava but found the free version of this app to be much better. AllTrails keeps trying to get me to pay for the premium version and it does look like it has really good additional features but even the free version is brilliant. 
I have told people at the gym about it and everyone is impressed with it.
author: KatGymDiva

title: App great but…

No idea what/which maps ARE downloaded (in Ireland right now - I did a download before in UK - which/what maps were they? Where are they now?). So / basically - chewed through a chunk of my data (cellular - which is fine - my choice) with little idea of how many times I’ve redownloaded the same things because it keeps saying - interrupted do you wish to restart. Great app to use for actually following a trail. Nightmare in terms of transparency and control regarding downloads.

content: Amazing app for beginners and anyone who hikes to discover new areas or find new routes and trails around regular walks. A lot of apps give you routes but what all trails excels at is the reviews. author: SRK5966

This app provides all the knowledge of local routes and navigation that you could need. For extreme remote long distance trekking, proper gps/ orienteering skills are probably a safer bet, but for getting out on day hikes this app is perfect

title: Great app for finding new walks
content: I’m enjoying this app for finding new walks. The offline maps are helpful and the reviews and photos are useful too. If it had OS maps it would be perfect but as far as it goes it works better than many other apps out there.

Great otherwise
author: LemonadeKing

author: Nord tripe

title: Love this app!
content:
This app is brilliant for getting out anywhere for an adventure. You can drive to any destination, click on the maps and pick a route. Easy to use, accurate and you can filter routes to suit your walking ability/preference. 
I highly recommend the pro version, so handy to download the maps to work offline, plus you get a notification if you go off route. 
Brilliant 👍 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
author: Bexx140

title: Love it
content: Great app for hiking. One minor issue, I feel like when I started using it, there was no option to share saved lists. Then at some point it was added with Public as default. Now I have to go through all of them and update the settings one by one, because I have no intention to share it. There should be an option of bulk change.
author: Furnas1234

title: Paid for free trial?
content: The app let me take out a free trial with no probable m, only to find out I was charged a full year subscription. AllTrails could not refund directly and are unable to explain why I was charged for a free trial. They said ‘someone at my address may have take a sun before’ which sounds absolutely a joke. I had to contact Apple for a refund as they were also unable to refund directly. This aside, I tried the app on a hike in Norway and I didn’t like it at all. Distances and positioning were never accurate, despite having Wi-Fi and GPS along most of the trail and using downloaded maps. Not recommended
author: Lycia92

title: Get yourself a proper map - don’t waste money on premium.
content: I was tempted by the free trial to see if AllTrails premium will unlock topo maps as these detailed - such as OS maps. Unfortunately not, all you get is some sort of watered down version of a topographic map, where you have no clue whether you are taking a pathway or a bridleway - important for off-road cycling in the UK. So all the filters for activities are useless too as you might select Mountain biking but you will end up on regular pathways without the ability to check the map. Apple has refused a refund twice now so can’t get my money back either. Rubbish!
author: Loveagoodmoan

title: Why remove the map from the Watch app
content:
Became a premium subscriber last month after being impressed with having a map of my route available on the Watch app which was super convenient and better than getting my phone out repeatedly.

Disappointed to find this weekend that this now been replaced with a compass which is nowhere near as useful or reliable. AllTrails only remains useful for me for route discovery now. Will be looking to explore downloading GPX files into other services that will provide an Apple Watch map.
author: Sean_Howard

title: Perfect for all sports from walking to kayaking!
content: This truly is a very versatile application! The stats are spot on, the mapping is brilliantly designed, plot your route with wayward points and phots.. elevation recordings to declines, distance to reminders through text to rejoin your route if you wonder off! Very impressed.. it does everything you need and more! Mostly it’s simple to use! Very user friendly ❤️
author: Cetus1

title: Nightmare when upgrading to Pro
content:
I love the Hiking App function but both myself and my Partner have had problems with the subscription to upgrade to Pro. 

We have spent two days trying to resolve the issue. Now the company are trying to merge our accounts despite having paid for two subscriptions and we use separately. 

The problem arose with a promotional email offering 50% discount which I forwarded to my Partner to use. Possibly part our error but it should be easy to remedy and isn’t. Suggest caution and really read when upgrading so users don’t have the bad experience we are having.
author: puss in hiking boots

title: This App Is Excellent!
content: I was around 1 hour away from my home there was No signal and only 4G. For some reason I was unable to connect to google maps and i was lost around 1 hour away from home. I only have a few map apps on my phone and none of them could connect; however, this one could? I easily navigated my way home! This app is excellent and i would recommend this to anyone!
author: hahdvdkafauvfnd

content:

It wouldn’t restart correctly, and required a force quit. Afterwards, the entire history of the previous 20 miles was gone. I’ll be looking for something more reliable for future hikes.
author: Richcliffe

content:
Have the free versions. Kept us safe on trails. Really good navigating even when slightly off the track. 
Would recommend to anyone wanting to take the plunge! 
The trail synopsis are really good. And being able to leave reviews even in the free version really helps you select the right trails for family, couples, mood, weather conditions etc.
author: Psychobillypunkhybrid

title: Very good
content: This app is very good and has some useful features if you subscribe to an annual subscription such as telling you that you gone off your trail. Some of the descriptions are not correct where it says that dogs are not allowed. Dogs are allowed but on the lead. This is the case for walks in Cornwall and have fed this back to all trails once we did the walks so hopefully they will update the descriptions.
author: Tallgirl

title: Good hiking app
content: I really like the social aspect of the app and the fact that it makes finding new trails so easy. Cons are: submitting new trails is a pain and take ages to be approved and also app has a nasty habit of switching itself off while navigating when you use other apps and it’s incredibly frustrating as it stops recording your hike- this never happened with OS Maps app
author: Marc0057

title: No on trail weather
content: I used this app last year and for the most part I loved it. It connected to my Apple Watch and would alert me when I got 25-50 meters off the route. Great feature. One of the features I really liked was the weather forecast along the trail.  A very important feature. But now since they got the upgrade to the Peak version they’ve taken it out of the Plus version. That’s cheeky!!! I paid for that option in the Plus version!!! Now you’ve taken it out? So now the Plus is pretty basic. I doubt that I’ll renew.
author: Lucdc

title: Exploring made easy!
content: Great app! Would definitely recommend, makes it really easy to just rock up somewhere and go exploring without the stress of having to figure out a route or get lost. Only thing that would help is if they have a postcode for the start point of the walk to make driving to start point easier if that’s what you’re doing.
author: Hiker!

title: Love it!
content: I’m using the paid version of this app and it is worth every penny! Hiking without this app seems impossible now! There are so many trails to choose from and I love that you can download any trail as there is rarely connection where we hike. There is nothing I don’t like about this app. Would definitely recommend for anyone that enjoys walking/hiking!!
author: Human10110

title: Please keep it free. Remember your integrity sanctify your soul.
content: I would say work on building the community add more social features turn it into a Strava for hikers other than that keep on the good work this is one of the top five best apps that anybody can have. I would be proud to work for this company and I would feel honoured knowing that I was a part of such a brilliant and genuinely useful piece of equipment
author: Godand Moses

title: Well worth subscription
content: Thought I would give this a go and have not been disappointed at all. There is so much on here we are spoiled for choice. You can even make your own roots up. We first use it just for hiking but there is so much more.,we now use it for dog walks, paddle boarding mountain biking and even if just fancy a nice chilled walk, but somewhere different.
author: Jase Tom.

title: The best app for hikers
content: I organise a walking group and over a couple of years we have tried several apps out there. AllTrails is easily my favourite. Simple to use with downloadable maps and clear markings of footpaths and bridleways. I’ve just started recording the walks with pictures on the app which is a great feature so others can enjoy the walks we do.
author: chirissieb

title: Fix GPS issues
content: Great app and good walkers community around the world. However, GPS stopped working almost all the time in the past few months. I don’t know if it’s a buggy update but it’s a real shame as I’ve been a fan and premium subscriber for years but I end up getting disappointed all the time as non of my activities are registered accurately as it constantly displays “no gps signal”
author: Ducswalking

title: Fantastic
content: Great App for helping explore new places. You can easily search for walks by location, distance, difficulty, features and the App is easy to use while your hiking to navigate the route. I have been meaning to get out and explore the Peak District for ages, but as a solo walker worried that I’d get lost. This was a great find and I’ve already been out for a lovely hike! Recommend.
author: LizzSummers

title: Awesome app and fab customer service!
content:
Fab app, been using it for over a year  and it’s incredibly accurate, can submit your own trails and review too! There was a slight issue which was reported and had received a reply incredibly quickly and the issue was sorted there and then!! 

Fab app, definitely recommend!! Plus lifeline button if you get into bother!!
author: Gabriellegaige

title: Misleading pricing & poor value
content:
originally left a 1-star review because I felt the app wasn’t worth the £79 I was charged after the trial. Since then, I’ve discovered AllTrails is advertising the exact same subscription for £29. When I raised this with support, they told me the lower price is only for “new upgrades” and there’s nothing they can do for existing subscribers.

This feels extremely unfair and misleading — I’ve paid more than double the going rate for a product that hasn’t proven useful to me. Between the poor value, inconsistent pricing, and unhelpful support, I can’t recommend this app.
author: Laralouiseg

title: If only Apple Watch gps has no issues, it would have been perfect.
content:
Great use for those that are starting to walk/hike. Though the gps inaccuracy for the Apple Watch is quite a bummer. The features in the app is easy to use and detailed enough for enthusiasts. Especially love the review section and the photo section, really make this app stands out.

Please fix the Apple Watch gps issues! Thanks!
author: 12138xxx

title: Recording Walking Routes
content:
Just started using the app to record my longer walks. Great to look back on and also good that I can keep a history of where I have been.
I have found that the app does drain the phone battery so will get a new battery fitted to my iPhone, and make sure I have 100% charge. Just wonder if it would last on a full days outing.
author: Ronanddogs

title: Love the app, but recent glitches are frustrating
content:
I really love the AllTrails app and use it all the time. However, lately the app has been extremely glitchy, which has been very frustrating, especially as a Peak subscriber.

I genuinely want to keep loving and using this app, but if these issues aren’t fixed soon, I’ll have to reconsider renewing my Peak subscription.

Please fix the app so we can continue using it in 2026 without having to cancel.
author: KoEdo82

title: Good for discovery
content:
This is a good app to find hikes and get user reviews. It is also useful to download the map to check the route of not in coverage. 

The slightly annoying thing is that sometimes when switching to the app, it reverts to the start view (looking for nearby trails) rather than the trail that was already being followed. In an area with poor data signal the app tends to freeze on this screen for a short while
author: iain1248

title: Great selection of trails
content:
Great selection of various trails, also you can see the map and other paths which allows you to modify the walk as you want (make it longer/shorter). Also nice to see people photos which gives better understanding of the trail. 
Overall love this app, and highly recommend.
author: Insula21

title: Opened new places!
content: Loving this app. It’s made us discover places on our doorstep and places far away. Just watch the battery use on those long walks! We’ve found it helps to download it first then turn off mobile phone data during the walk. You only need to peek at the route every now and then.
author: pishcook

title: Great App
content: Loving the extent of the content. Locally in the UK it’s great but we are going to Switzerland in the summer and finding it has all of Switzerland too is brilliant. content:

2. Distance remainder reported as 11.3 mi half way through journey. 
3. App gets confused when journey ends on same path as start, continuously cycling between sending us back to restart route from current position one moment, to then giving instructions to complete the route. Distance remaining also cycles in the same way. 

We lost count how many times the route, app and phone had to be restarted to complete the chosen route. 

If you choose a long route in backcountry away from civilisation, current app version is dangerous to rely on!!

originally left a 1-star review because I felt the app wasn’t worth the £79 I was charged after the trial. Since then, I’ve discovered AllTrails is advertising the exact same subscription for £29. We’ve used it to find walks in Ireland and France and it’s great. Locally known trails that you wouldn’t find alone. Also good for cycling. We’ve tried many walking apps and this is by far the best.
author: AlmostFFF

title: Fantastic app for some excellent routes
content:
This app has been brilliant for finding some really brilliant walks in my area and beyond. 
The directions are always clear but it things are obvious, you can rely on the GPS to perfectly pinpoint exactly where you are. 
The free version is perfectly functional for some fine walks. Enjoy!
author: Neocarty

title: Brilliant app
content: I’ve enjoyed this app for few years now and never had any problems with it. My highlight of it that it gives you directions to get to any walks as I have no sense of it whatsoever. It does use a lot of battery but I just go with fully charged phone and it never died on me yet. Best 40 quid spent!
author: Lilly 1993

title: Great app
content:
What a fantastic app, gives me the info I want. 
I never stick to new year resolutions, but this year I decided I’d like to walk 1200 miles with our dog, this app is showing me I’m on target. 
I’d must say though, I’d like to monitor the dog also as sure she must do 5 times my walk. 
Great app, thank you. Helping to keep an old man and his dog a little fitter.
author: blakes @

title: First time using the alltrails app.
content:
I started using the app this week, I forgot to shut it down after my first hike with our cocker spaniel Barney so it added the drive back. I used one of the online trails this morning and it was spot on all the way through the hike, definitely recommend it to anyone who walks deep into the New forest.

regards Mal
author: ukmac1

title: Brilliant App, issues now fixed!
content: By far and away the best app I have come across to discover new walks and to record your progress.  I did experience some stability issues with a recent update, but these have now all been fixed for me.  Truly excellent app and excellent response to any reported issues.
author: Julesman101

title: Drains Battery In Navigation Mode
content: Whilst this is a great app with lots of routes and quality maps the major flaw with it is that you can not switch off the Navigator mode.  This drains the phones battery which can be annoying on long walks.  I don’t need to track my routes as I have numerous apps on my watch that does this so just want to view the route from time to time to ensure I’m still on track.
author: Stackerbo

title: Apple Watch issues
content:
On the iPhone. It does a great job. Having my phone out whilst hiking though, killed the vibe of being out in the wild and switching off from the world. 

When I saw that you could use your Apple Watch instead of having your phone out, I used the free trial. I was able to use the map on my Apple Watch and it gave the route directions for me to follow. 

I thought it was a great feature. Now that I have the paid version - it does not work at all. I just get the map and it does not display the route. This seems pointless. 

The Apple Watch also lags or just doesn’t link to the phone app 80% of the time, even if I’ve downloaded the offline map. 

Can this be resolved. I would like a refund too - can someone provide me with contact details for this please.
author: Jizzum monster

title: Subscription started without warning
content:
The first walk I did from this app took me on a route that would have entailed climbing up onto boulders ten foot above a raging river, without warning or alternative options, which resulted in my family and I having to turn back. 
I had no intention of subscribing, however after a week’s free trial, the money for an annual subscription was taken from my bank account without any contact from the company or an obvious option to decline. Make sure you really want this app before you try it.
author: Hhmum

title: Arguably the best app around
content: If you enjoy a walk, this is the app for you. So many great recommendations for walks, I have used this in a number of locations across England and it never fails to deliver. So easy to follow routes with GPS enabled maps, making the need for old school written instructions a thing of the past. Trust me, this app is great!
author: stokie91

title: Update has ruined app
content: I pay for pro to get trails downloaded, new update meant all maps needed updating, which is all well and good. But the downloads fail and won’t reconnect no matter what I try, closing and restarting app, force restart of phone. Really not happy, why ‘fix’ something that wasn’t broken?!
author: Sarahnjr2011

title: Fantastic app
content: I love this app. So useful for making sure you’re on track when paths get a bit vague and also for finding new walks when you’re not familiar with the area. Nice that you can make and share you own walks too, plus add reviews and pictures to remind yourself of lovely days out
author: Happybirdie......

title: Very useful app
content: I started using this app in Madeira and without it wouldn’t have found the start of the trails and it kept me right on the track when the track wasn’t obvious or there were options to follow. Recently using it in Gran Canaria and again it’s invaluable at finding hidden lesser known trails.
author: Xgreyup

title: Has been so useful
content:
We have used the free app for helping to walk the Thames Towpath. Many a time it has come in very useful when dealing with forced detours and foot bridge closures as well as general checking of the route. Easy to stray!

Intend to buy the full version when we become more adventurous with our hikes. 

Thank you All trails!
author: OBear48

title: Great App keeps you moving more
content:
Great App for keeping your moving more. It is so easy to search the trails which fits your needs. Best App!!
A suggestion is if it can have colour coding feature for the lists created by the user so that the routes saved in the lists will show the colour when it is shown in searches.
author: Love_in_the_mist

title: Great app for any activity
content: Great app. I find it really helpful you can zoom out and turn around maps and also seeing other people’s photos and comments is very helpful . Used to have a free version but paid version is worth it as I often hike in the areas with no reception
author: Huds&Sharks

title: Great for tracking runs and walks
content: I love this for tracking my runs. Showing my kids how far they’ve walked when hikes are feeling tough. We can revisit places we have been and go further or take different routes and find walks close by when in areas we don’t know so well.
author: KCurz

title: Better functionality in free version
content: Enjoying the app. However, for the free version it would be good if your completed walks marked in a different colour in map view once completed. I would be more likely to try and tick off lots of different walks of I could see more easily the ones I have done previously when searching in map view.
author: kp283

title: Suggestion
content:
I love this app, I just subscribed to the free trial and it has pleased me so far on my first trip. 

One thing that is missing is the detail that traditional walking guide books offer. For example, “on your left you will see a old cottage” + include river names (anything that will improve knowledge as you walk)
author: Adrian🎶

title: Great app if you’re happy following well known routes.
content:
Otherwise, the IX is painful and time consuming.  Simpler to add or create new trails, and it would be a five star. 
Uploading race routes is a new level of hell. 

Would also be great to merge existing routes :) 
Edit… thanks for your response, but it doesn’t address my comment. I’m a fan, I use AllTrails+ every week, but the functionality to add trails on demand, while useful, is half baked. The joy of trails is exploring, I can’t do that with plans in a request queue!
author: Demandajane

title: Great app!
content: This app is brilliant, great choices of walks and it tracks your GPS location even without phone service so the trails are very easy to follow. I used it in conjunction with an OS map to teach me how to map read accurately and determine our exact location, highly recommend and pleased I’ve found it.
author: SimonR6

title: Great maps
content:
I love all trail maps, specially the 3D view.
Also great selection of routes. 
However, it misses a key functionality: create your own route from the mobile app. Also the ability of exporting gpx routes from the app. 
A garmin watch app would be game changer as well. All this is offered by other platforms like Komoot so, much room for improvement.
author: eduhardisson

title: Inferior to the app they took over
content: I was a happily using View Ranger for years, paying for some premium routes but able to access and download a large selection of routes for free. Along comes All Trails with its flashy visuals and poor usability demanding I upgrade for everything. At least have the decency to transfer my existing credits on View Ranger or refund me. Let me know when you have tested this app with real walkers in a lab and I will consider giving it another go. Until then I’ll try and find another open source provider.
author: JanieC14

title: Took my money…
content:
First off I only downloaded this app to see if it was what I was looking for.. it wasn’t but then they decided to charge me £30 for it. This app is ok if you want to follow in someone else’s shoes on a route, if you like comment sections,  pictures etc.. it’s basically another social media site but for hiking.. I don’t dig that at all. I wanted to plan out my own running routes in the Alps but this was not possible unless you have a laptop…I don’t carry one about I’m afraid… especially out running on the fells… 

I did how ever find a much better app where you can plot your own routes and it worked perfect for me.
It’s called ‘Ourdoor active’ and it’s cheaper.. 

But now I’m back in the UK I will go back to my trusted OS map app!!
author: 60stelecaster

title: New update is so slow.
content:
I absolutely love AllTrails and UL until this last update it was the best app in the market. I have a walking club and adventure business and I rely on this app for my club walks. The latest update is so frustrating. There are now even more clicks and waits to reach your activity, the process of uploading your photos and having to hit “high five” each time makes the job even more ling winded. Things take ages to load. 

I miss the previous version.
author: JuliaDoherty

title: Hiking made easy
content: Previous years hardly hiked as much as I didn’t know of many routes and have no navigation skills. All Trails has changed that and has allowed me to hike and find some incredible routes over the past year. Highly recommend it
author: VishalB90

title: IFootpath was much better than this
content: I had iFootpath which allowed me to plan a walk before actually walking the route. All Trails has replaced iFootpath and does not have this feature. The only way to check distance and geography is to walk the route and record it or to use the far superior Google Maps! There is no search facility in the so called Plan function, so to find a place you need to scroll around the map and zoom in. There are no help pages to explain the layers that have to be downloaded either. Missing very basic features.
author: GodSoLovedTheWorldJohn316

title: So far so good
content: Very impressed with the app overall. I’ve always been wary of solo hiking with navigation and direction but with this app it’s changed everything. The routes are good and there’s a tonne of options. GPS is bang on and access to other walk reviews is also a good help in preparation. Highly reccomend.
author: Matt3490

title: User friendly navigation app
content: Have been using Alltrails for 6 years now and have used it in Canada, America and across Europe. Very useful, easy to use trail app giving me the confidence to go out on a hike by myself without the fear of getting lost! Would strongly recommend to anyone who was unsure of splashing out.
author: S Van Chesters

title: Disappointed
content: I found it really frustrating that I couldn’t plan my own hikes on my mobile whilst on holiday because walks can only be planned on a computer or laptop. This is a major flaw for me and sets all hikes way below apps like outdoor active. Basically if you don’t have your computer with you you are restricted to following, and not deviating from, what other people have uploaded. Other mapping apps are far better for this at a similar price.
author: RMB2123

title: Save battery app
content: Love this app. Will find trails for hiking almost anywhere - have used in US and U.K. and across Europe. What is brilliant is that you can download the app, switch off your mobile roaming or data to save battery and the downloaded map will work off GPS and navigate as you go.
author: buauaer

title: Pram friendly?
content: Either I’m missing something or there isn’t a way to filter out pram friendly walks. My son is autistic and uses an off road pram which is fine on stony paths but extremely tiresome through bogs and muddy fields. There’s lots of search tags including dog friendly, child friendly etc. Can one be added for pram friendly please!
author: LaughingBrush

title: Makes it so easy
content: I love using All Trails. Almost wherever I go, All Trails makes it easy to find nearby trails, etc, and thanks to the large community, there are typically useful reviews, tips and photos that help me decide what hikes to choose. It’s comprehensive and works well. Has improved my family’s holidays!
author: HZ

title: Useful app - great if you are new to an area looking for inspiration
content: I’m new to this app - but rate it highly after using it 9 times in the last few weeks. Best carrying unnecessary maps, and only a few minor moments when I lost my signal - pretty soon the blue marker comes back to the tight place & sets you on your way again.
author: first martyr

title: Best walking app going
content:
Done so many on all trails now and can’t recommend it enough .
If you pay it is worth while as you can have the maps downloaded before you arrive .
Especially in wales where the signal is poor
author: Lurcherman7831

title: Loses State Constantly
content:
Typical experience with this app: launch. It somehow has forgotten everything it ever knew about local trails and needs "up to one minute" to figure itself out again. Either log in or skip, it makes no difference. See a long list of trails, pick one.

But if, at any point, you dare commit the sin of going to the iPhone home screen, Alltrails will kick you all the way back out to the start.

Oh, except you might be in the middle of your hike now. So good luck finding a phone signal. If you should fail? No information, no map for you!
author: HarteyBoy

title: Finding great trails
content: AllTrails has a great selection of tested routes to find and use . However the lack of verbal directions is v disappinting . This means you have to constantly be looking at the screen which drains the phones battery whereas simple verbal instructions would avoid this.  Also verbal instructions are better on a bike  Having recently swopped from using Footpaths I am missing this functionality .
author: Melaar

title: Best navigation app for hiking
content:
I’ve used quite a few navigation apps but this is the best one yet
Has all the top hikes readily available and lots of alternatives that you wouldn’t usually be aware of
Lots of map type options to download and easy to use when navigating
author: brandonflowers90

title: Great app, bad update
content: Before the recent update I could load a trail map and view it on my Apple Watch. Incredibly helpful to check the route rather than get your phone out every few minutes. This feature has now been removed. Are there plans to bring this back? Updates should improve functionality and user experience, not reduce it.
author: Karakal87

title: It’s a fantastic App
author: ZalpinXBai

title: This app changed my life!
content: During the pandemic and lockdown I was getting cabin fever. Is needed to get out of the house and discovered hiking. This app allowed us to discover some wonderful places, beautiful scenery and some lovely pubs along the way! Getting out in nature has an amazing effect on your body and mind. Thank you AllTrails!
author: Kuljeet7

title: Keeps letting me down
content: As a cyclist I like to record my trips. Using this recently it has let me down 3 times in 8 outings. Today, I stopped my journey for a ‘call of nature’ afterwards I restarted the clock and walked along to ensure it was still recording the route. As soon as I saw it click over to next hundredth of a km I put phone in pocket without touching the screen further. Arrived home and it had failed to log the second part of the journey. To be honest it worked well for a long time and is now unreliable.
author: Colincqw

title: Superb app
content: The map is excellent and is very well detailed. My favourite feature is that you can download the map and use it offline for when the signals bad, only using gps to get a location. This means you can navigate in airplane mode and save a tonne of phone battery!
author: robbo5903

title: Love this App
content:
I use this app on a weekly basis. It is so handy to discover new places if you enjoy walking. I’ve even used it when I travel. 
It’s helped open up every place I’ve gone, without it, I would have missed out on so many beautiful views. Highly recommend
author: LN212.

title: Great for the phone …
content:
It’s a great app, really love it, it’s only fault is that I can’t access it on more devices. It could really do with an iPad app. I also bought the premium version because I was excited to use the Apple Watch feature. It was such a let down, not even a map feature for a maps app.
Developers, please work on your other apps across devices.
author: Bob Bob Bob bobob

If features have been removed from the app at the price agreed when signing up, i feel i am due a full refund for the years subscription. Very very unhappy!
author: Ahdhfjenxhxh

title: Only Usable If Pay
content: Totally misleading. This is not "in-app purchases", this is ONLY usable if you pay a subscription, and a hefty one at that. You cannot view even one page without signing up and the moment you sign up you're told you get 7 days "trial" for free but from then on you are charged. That is: after 7 days there is nothing to see without paying. As soon as I saw that I deleted it. Why not be up front and state this clearly before people waste their time?
author: TheMouseLady

title: Reliable
content: Very reliable, so long as you have the premium membership (includes downloading offline maps). This app has saved me from a pickle, but…. Still make sure you are paper map and compass trained, there is only so far tech can get you!
author: Hike to my death

title: Flawed offline usage
content: Great app for finding and following trails online, but tried the plus version for trekking remote and offline, but is unreliable. The rest of the app can’t load offline, so accessing downloaded maps is fragile at best. Once getting it going offline it constantly failed to track and update progress. Watch also kept disconnecting and failing to load. If this could be made robust I’d happily subscribe again.
author: sampeckham

title: Really helpful
content: Having the pictures and all the recommendations on how difficult and long the trail is can really assist me in deciding which walks to do. The added bonus of the pictures other people have taken on the trails helps me make the decision if the views are worth it.
author: lozzy132

title: Great suggestions for exploring the UK
content:
We really like the suggestions when exploring a new place, the maps on the app are pretty easy to follow and get back on track when you do miss a turn. I love it for new running locations in the UK.

Well worth the subscription!
author: Explorer Lianne

title: W4nderWom4n

author: W4nderW0m4n

author: Tylersm90

content:
I really like the AllTrails app. It is very easy to use, has never let me down and pretty good value.

author: lizf15

title: Amazing App
