content: I love using All Trails. Almost wherever I go, All Trails makes it easy to find nearby trails, etc, and thanks to the large community, there are typically useful reviews, tips and photos that help me decide what hikes to choose. It’s comprehensive and works well. Has improved my family’s holidays!
author: HZ

title: Useful app - great if you are new to an area looking for inspiration
content: I’m new to this app - but rate it highly after using it 9 times in the last few weeks. Best carrying unnecessary maps, and only a few minor moments when I lost my signal - pretty soon the blue marker comes back to the tight place & sets you on your way again.
author: first martyr

title: Best walking app going
content:
Done so many on all trails now and can’t recommend it enough .
If you pay it is worth while as you can have the maps downloaded before you arrive .
Especially in wales where the signal is poor
author: Lurcherman7831

title: Loses State Constantly
content:
Typical experience with this app: launch. It somehow has forgotten everything it ever knew about local trails and needs "up to one minute" to figure itself out again. Either log in or skip, it makes no difference. See a long list of trails, pick one.

But if, at any point, you dare commit the sin of going to the iPhone home screen, Alltrails will kick you all the way back out to the start.

Oh, except you might be in the middle of your hike now. So good luck finding a phone signal. If you should fail? No information, no map for you!
author: HarteyBoy

title: Finding great trails
content: AllTrails has a great selection of tested routes to find and use . However the lack of verbal directions is v disappinting . This means you have to constantly be looking at the screen which drains the phones battery whereas simple verbal instructions would avoid this.  Also verbal instructions are better on a bike  Having recently swopped from using Footpaths I am missing this functionality .
author: Melaar

title: Best navigation app for hiking
content:
I’ve used quite a few navigation apps but this is the best one yet
Has all the top hikes readily available and lots of alternatives that you wouldn’t usually be aware of
Lots of map type options to download and easy to use when navigating
author: brandonflowers90

title: Great app, bad update
content: Before the recent update I could load a trail map and view it on my Apple Watch. Incredibly helpful to check the route rather than get your phone out every few minutes. This feature has now been removed. Are there plans to bring this back? Updates should improve functionality and user experience, not reduce it.
author: Karakal87

title: It’s a fantastic App
author: ZalpinXBai

title: This app changed my life!
content: During the pandemic and lockdown I was getting cabin fever. Is needed to get out of the house and discovered hiking. This app allowed us to discover some wonderful places, beautiful scenery and some lovely pubs along the way! Getting out in nature has an amazing effect on your body and mind. Thank you AllTrails!
author: Kuljeet7

title: Keeps letting me down
content: As a cyclist I like to record my trips. Using this recently it has let me down 3 times in 8 outings. Today, I stopped my journey for a ‘call of nature’ afterwards I restarted the clock and walked along to ensure it was still recording the route. As soon as I saw it click over to next hundredth of a km I put phone in pocket without touching the screen further. Arrived home and it had failed to log the second part of the journey. To be honest it worked well for a long time and is now unreliable.
author: Colincqw

title: Superb app
content: The map is excellent and is very well detailed. My favourite feature is that you can download the map and use it offline for when the signals bad, only using gps to get a location. This means you can navigate in airplane mode and save a tonne of phone battery!
author: robbo5903

title: Love this App
content:
I use this app on a weekly basis. It is so handy to discover new places if you enjoy walking. I’ve even used it when I travel. 
It’s helped open up every place I’ve gone, without it, I would have missed out on so many beautiful views. Highly recommend
author: LN212.

title: Great for the phone …
content:
It’s a great app, really love it, it’s only fault is that I can’t access it on more devices. It could really do with an iPad app. I also bought the premium version because I was excited to use the Apple Watch feature. It was such a let down, not even a map feature for a maps app.
Developers, please work on your other apps across devices.
author: Bob Bob Bob bobob

title: Why have you removed the option to plot new custom routes unless paying extra?
content: This app was one of my favourites but at some point (after my subscription renewed for the not inconsiderable charge of around £35) the ability to plot custom routes and download sections of map has been removed unless i upgrade to the £90+ tier. If features have been removed from the app at the price agreed when signing up, i feel i am due a full refund for the years subscription. Very very unhappy!
author: Ahdhfjenxhxh

title: Only Usable If Pay
content: Totally misleading. This is not "in-app purchases", this is ONLY usable if you pay a subscription, and a hefty one at that. You cannot view even one page without signing up and the moment you sign up you're told you get 7 days "trial" for free but from then on you are charged. That is: after 7 days there is nothing to see without paying. As soon as I saw that I deleted it. Why not be up front and state this clearly before people waste their time?
author: TheMouseLady

title: Reliable
content: Very reliable, so long as you have the premium membership (includes downloading offline maps). This app has saved me from a pickle, but…. Still make sure you are paper map and compass trained, there is only so far tech can get you!
author: Hike to my death

title: Flawed offline usage
content: Great app for finding and following trails online, but tried the plus version for trekking remote and offline, but is unreliable. The rest of the app can’t load offline, so accessing downloaded maps is fragile at best. Once getting it going offline it constantly failed to track and update progress. Watch also kept disconnecting and failing to load. If this could be made robust I’d happily subscribe again.
author: sampeckham

title: Really helpful
content: Having the pictures and all the recommendations on how difficult and long the trail is can really assist me in deciding which walks to do. The added bonus of the pictures other people have taken on the trails helps me make the decision if the views are worth it.
author: lozzy132

title: Great suggestions for exploring the UK
content:
We really like the suggestions when exploring a new place, the maps on the app are pretty easy to follow and get back on track when you do miss a turn. I love it for new running locations in the UK.

Well worth the subscription!
author: Explorer Lianne

title: W4nderWom4n
content: AllTrails is great but having used it for the last 3 years I’m noticing it doesn’t have many Corbetts or Marylins on its trails… however for every other map I have used which is a lot it’s been the only thing to give me confidence to know I can out there on my own and feel safe without getting lost !
author: W4nderW0m4n

title: Excellent
content: Great for finding new places to go. Excellent Ideas for things to do when away from home and just tracking where you wander if your just following your nose and need help getting back to your starting location.
author: Tylersm90

title: Great App - easy to use
content:
I really like the AllTrails app. It is very easy to use, has never let me down and pretty good value. 
Only things I would change is the message when you have gone off your route comes in a bit late sometimes and it would be good if you could filter by Wainwright, Marilyn or Monroe.
author: lizf15

title: Amazing App
content: Whoever came up with this needs a medal. Usually we get so lost on our walks and it can be a struggle to find a proper guide on the internet. We most recently did pen y fan and followed the guide. Was 100% accurate and I don’t think we would’ve coped without. Well worth the money
author: Just set and suiugf

title: Not very useful and shady app
content: I didn’t find the app any better that others I’ve used. If anything worse, so I decided to cancel. I was logged out of the account straight away and not able to get back in  even after emailing the company. Apparently a conformation email was being sent but is not to be found. They have now taken money for a subscription they knew in advance I didn’t want and won’t return my money even with all the transaction and account details.
author: Igglepoporiginal

title: Phenomenal
content: Love this app! Not only does it have almost all trails (name on point) but also provides detailed information about the trail like elevation etc. Also keeps track of your path so you can see what trails you’ve explored on a trip, or in case you get lost!
author: HanAtir

title: Good app but too many pop-ups!
content: The app is great but there are too many prompts to buy the premium version. Also, the premium version is too expensive. A one-off buy package I would consider but a monthly subscription is too much.
author: BootstrapJack

title: Feature locked
content: I would be happy to pay plus fees if I could create and modify my own routes. It’s ridiculous this is locked in the peak tier for £80 a year. Just save that tier for your AI tools? It’s a good app, nice interface and smooth operation, but I’ve cancelled my subscription and won’t restart it until these features are available for the plus tier. Very frustrating.
author: Things1234567

title: Superb app!
content: My husband and I downloaded this a few days back before we set off to Bibury in the Cotswolds. A stunning app and guided us on a family 12km walk! Did not realise there were also so many walks and running routes close to my home in bushey too! A great app and have already shared this with so many others! Thanks. MJohn
author: bushey M John

title: Great app, just a suggestion
content:
Not sure if this feature was ever available in the past, I feel like it was but I could be wrong - we need the ability to search walks within a playlist.

Walks need to include trig points as points of interest, then we could filter for walks that have trig points on them.
author: The chomping monk

title: Best walking app
content: The best app I’ve found. Could be improved if you could reliably search for say ‘waterfalls’ but I find this function doesn’t work perfectly. The app itself is fantastic though. Would highly recommend.
author: I see shapes

title: Good app
content: A good trail app but could be brilliant if you could view the length of the walk and whether it was a loop walk or one way on the list of walks. At the moment you need to click on a walk to find out the above details. This can be frustrating when looking for a minimum 6 mile walk and you keep clicking on 1-3 mile walks. Change this and I’d give it 5 stars!
author: sandiemh

title: Great app
content: This app has changed my life. Im out all the time and have already seen so much of my home country i could and would have missed. Im going abroad with it also now and would definitely highly recommend getting this.
author: Steiny666

title: Works and key features are free
content: I am impressed with this app. It is really good at finding interesting walks all over the country, excellent selection criteria and it is free. You can get the pro version, but either I don’t walk enough, or the free features just meets all my needs.
author: littlemonkey3210

title: Nice for 2.5hours
content:
The app seems fantastic, but it completely drained my phone in 2.5hours.. not useful at all.. lucky me I was not wondering in the wild too far. :D Considering the price with the heavy battery usage - sorry that is my rating for you.
What is the point if I can go out only 2hours? I should not carry plenty of power banks so I can use my phone if I want to explore an entire day..
author: all nickname is taken 2456

title: Public transport please!!
content: Such a great app but so limiting if you don’t drive as there’s no public transport only option and you can’t even really make out tram tracks on the map to work out where you can get to. Would be a great feature as currently have to go on every walk details section and stick it into Google to whittle down the options :(
author: LBP8596

title: Not useful for multi day hikes or route planning
content:
Generally pretty disappointed with AllTrails.

Pros are the maps which are detailed and easy to use. 

Some cons which will prevent me from renewing my subscription:

It’s extremely difficult to plan routes in the web app and impossible in the mobile app. 

It’s also unfortunately not possible to ask others in the community what conditions were like when they did a route which is very useful if you are trying to plan ahead and someone has completed a trail in the same region days before. 

It’s not possible to do routes in reverse which is frustrating. 

And multi-day routes are rare. I assume this is because there is very little curation happening.
author: jaypench

title: Great recommendations
content: We exclusively used this app when we were in Madeira, Portugal. With the family we used to find some easy walks, since we have a toddler. But I also used it to find some challenging routes for some trail running. Keep bringing more routes! ❤️🙌
author: RuiAAPeres

title: Just brilliant
content: Never stuck for anything to do. Wherever we are, we just do a search on the app and voila. The afternoon is sorted. Use user reviews also usually tell you if there is anything when I expected like particular muddy areas..
author: MarkyC1968

title: Wouldn’t recommend anything else, it’s amazing
content: Love AllTrails. Never fails to find a walk for me and my dog or always has walks that I want to seek out. Always tracks me on my walks and gives me different directions if I get lost. Such a good app to have if you are out walking
author: Teddys adventures

title: Happy Hiking!
content: Love this app so much, it gives me peace of mind that I won’t get lost when heading out on big adventures and I love that you can track your progress and miles. Also love that you can search for tailored trails i.e. dog friendly, waterfalls etc! So worth the money :)
author: dhshsk d

title: So helpful
content: A friend recommended this app and I can’t recommend it enough. I’ve taken up walking as a form of therapy and the trail maps have been super helpful for places I haven’t visited before that don’t have obvious tracks the whole route.
author: k_jchoo

title: Poor substitute for iFootpath
content: IFootpath (which sold out to AllTrails) was excellent as each walk gave detailed route descriptions and waymark points plus interesting facts about landmarks along the way, parking places etc. Despite promising what a great new “partnership” the move to AllTrails would constitute, the AllTrails routes are simply downloads of maps with no guidance whatsoever (apart from the former iFootpath routes). No hint given of why to take the route, things to see, possible hazards if dog walking. Better just to buy a map and work out a route for yourself. Very disappointing.
author: DJWTA

title: Apple Watch maps removed
content: Used for the first time in a little while. They have (for some unknown reason) removed the map function on Apple Watch, rendering the app fairly useless as you now have to keep taking your phone out of your pocket rather than look at your watch to check for directions. A shame as the app is otherwise good but this omission has made me cancel my subscription.
author: PabloMoon

title: My favourite app
content: Over 500 miles since January 24, if it wasn’t for alltrails my dog and I would not have been to half the places we’ve been to this year! One of the best apps I’ve ever used! It really unlocks then ability to get outside and explore the world!
author: “C:/WINDOWS/system32/cmd.exe”

title: Great app!
content:
Great app, brilliant for dog walking & has taken me to areas I wouldn’t have visited without it!

If I’m being really critical: battery efficiency could be improved & it would be nice to see trails added more frequently. I’d also rather see AllTrails+ available for a one-off payment rather than a subscription
author: Woody02380

title: Great app
content:
Easy to use and plenty of walks to suit everybody's abilities. Filters work great to find length of walk you want that day. 
Only negative would be no app for smartwatches even with the pro upgrade or the ability to download routes as a file an upload to watches
author: 89Tom19

title: Just one thing missing
content:
Superb app which has helped me make a regular habit of walking in interesting locations

Would benefit from aligning the map to one’s direction of travel when opening the phone as it’s frustrating to have to rotate it
author: NextAvailable

title: All hikes outside your door
content: This is the best app ive ever used for the hiking, walking etc. It never stopped working while we hike, when you make a pause for a photos, snack or a picnic you can pause the recording and it wont stop the app. You can return to recording anytime. Add photos after you finish the hike.
author: olga metz

title: Excellent app
content: Have used this many times and provides many routes to go and try as well as create your own. Can keep family informed of where you are which is a bonus.
author: BORIS074

title: Quality has declined
content:
For some reason waypoints have been removed. And the only way you can access maps offline is if you pay more.

It’s frustrating, for example I’d like to know more about my starting point - is there parking? Do I have to pay? etc. etc. All recently removed from each route. 

We bought iFootpath because of the quality of the routes and information. It has certainly gone downhill since All Trials bought them.
author: Trewhero

title: Great App
content: Great app that allows me to use books and maps then compare with what’s in the app. Then having decided on the route can easily stay on the tracks in real time. Take a spare battery to charge phones of out for a long day.
author: Michaelmith

title: Don’t know what we would do without this app now.
content: We have discovered so many walks we wouldn’t have known about had it not been for this app. We are getting out more than ever now and would highly recommend it.
author: Vixen 1970

title: Great app but please ADD WIDGETS!!
content:
This app is an absolute game changer and I use it every single time I go for a hike. Love the 3D modelling and the way I can share with family/friends in-app. 

But please add widgets! Every other app is doing this now and it is so useful, it would make me use the app more for everyday local strolls rather than just large walks/hikes.
author: Carlosshezza

title: Would be good if it would stop freezing
content: Dreadfully buggy app (I’m on a new phone with latest software). Can’t narrow down choices using tabs at top, because the whole app freezes up when trying and I’m not prepared to scroll through about 500 trails to find a walk of about 10k distance in my area. Sort out the filter problems and then I might - might - think of paying to use it
author: ruvhb

title: Blank screen with no Internet on iPhone.
content: When I was out walking yesterday I constantly had to wait 3-5 minutes each time I checked my all trail map, while waiting there is blank white screen, eventually it times out and shows the map, you can imagine the battery being run down while I am waiting for the map to show. I am a paid up subscriber, if this is not resolved on my next walk I am deleting my subscription.
author: Pintail120

title: Why charge for creating trails.
content: Why would you charge people money to fill your app full of content. Such a poor business choice.  You want people to pay your highest tier subscription to be able to add trials to your app.  No wonder the app is lacking on walks to go on.  So so many missing because you are forcing people to pay to include their already known trial. You should make that free.  Then charge for the tracking. That would work much much better
author: Nozzzaa

title: Love this app
content: Absolutely love this app, it’s so handy to have when planning a walk! I love the fact it tells you figures after the walk such as how many calories burned and elevation. Haven’t been able to find another app like it! Lovely route ideas locally too and even make up your own!
author: emwilks

title: Apple Watch now next to useless
content: I moved to this app due to the functionality on the Apple Watch which has been all but removed. Where’s the maps gone?! The compass is useless and you now need to get your phone out at pretty much every turn. Please fix asap we need the map or a line to show which direction the trail goes as you approach a turn not after you’ve already walked past it!
author: V3gas

title: Sorry, I can’t recommend
content: I don’t like to leave negative reviews but we have found AllTrails pretty useless. The gps tracking often goes off kilter and when you do go off route the notification doesn’t happen. All this means you basically have to walk with your phone in your hand. Had to laugh on todays walk, according to the navigation map we were walking in the river!!
author: HectorPogle12

title: Great app for hikers and walkers
content: Love the app. Shows lots of trails with terrain and elevation changes. Have the Pro subscription which allow the user to download maps. This allows navigation in places with slow or no internet. Highly recommended
author: Brijesh7

title: Great app but missing a major feature.
content: Great app for finding a few new routes. However, what this app needs is a function where you can drop a pin on a location and then the app finds trail routes to get you there. I would love to see this feature added.
author: P ROPER

title: No reminder of end of trial and they would not refund you
content: Really disappointed how this app does not notify you that the free trial is ending and just charge you the annual fee directly after the 7 days of trial. I’ve requested for a refund twice right after they charged explaining i had no intention of continuing the subscription which they rejected. All the other apps I use have a few days where you can cancel the subscription within 7-14 days. But not this one.
author: indira1410

title: If you love exploring, get this app!
content: I absolutely love this app, especially as you can open it up anywhere and look up walks nearby. We have managed to explore so many great parts of the UK using this app. You can even use it abroad. The dog loves exploring new places too!
author: Pixiegarden26

title: Disorganised
content:
I was looking for an app that would give me local walks as well as further afield, however this app only gives me walks that, as an experienced walker, I have seen time and time again in other publications. 
The content of the app does not seem to have any categories, so choosing a walk in a given area is not simple as one has to trawl through lots of areas to find a walk of any relevance.
author: DPBoots

title: Make monthly subscription payments available
content: I would give 5 if there was an option to have monthly subscription options available too and not only year ones as that would give more flexibility because not everyone will be hiking or walking year round.
author: K00za

title: Walking with dogs
content: I’ve done several walks via this app with an old dog and it’s good to be able to see if the walk would be suitable ( or not) for her. I’ve only very occasionally gotten a little lost through missing or hidden signpost. I would ( and have) recommend this app
author: shaandcleo88

title: Life and lifestyle saver
content:
In today’s economy this is a bargain as if would have bought all the maps I needed for my ramblings I’d need to stay home for half of my walks.
All Trails never let me down and I hope it will stay for the years to come ❤️😍
author: meJHo19

title: Amazing for dog walks
content: We have found walks around our local area that are hidden gems. Like most things though, these apps want your money, which I have to say I am considering as the free version is so good, I am tempted to pay for a subscription
author: jamooki

title: Brilliant
content: Brilliant app with very accurate maps, great tips and recommendations from other users as well as pictures that help to decide if it’s the right route for what you want from a walk. Definitely worth the money
author: J2839

title: Perfect for walking holidays
content: We go around the UK walking a lot and this app helps us find the best trails in every area. It also gives you so much detail: distance, difficulty, reviews, photos. Would definitely recommend this app!!
author: countrybumpkinlady

title: Edit option pathetic
content:
Having been forced to come here, after the takeover of the ViewRanger app, I am truely appalled by the very basic editing options for routes. They are so bad it just easier to start again, than to try and edit recorded tracks. 
Plus the auto routing option just puts in random flashes off the sides for no reason at all.
I’m only here because I paid for the OS Whole of GB map pack back in the day.
Loved ViewRanger just bring that back, than this rubbish.
author: Salvelion

title: Please add “ Off Road Cycling “
content:
You have mountain biking, road biking, bike touring but no off road biking option. Many walking paths allow you to cycle, some don’t. 
You are missing a whole section of people who don’t want to mountain bike and don’t want to go on the road, they just want to ride safely on tracks (that are cycle allowed).
Can you try to incorporate that please.
author: Jimmcoll

title: Good information from other walkers
content: Use AllTrails to back up route planning on OS app and for non uk walks ( USA and NI).  Info on trail conditions from other walkers is accurate and good to take on board.   Route tracking and directions also easy to use
author: 61Markb

title: Great app… but
content:
It’s amazing app… however… if you don’t need to use it for about ten minutes while you’re walking on a single trail, it will completely forget where you are, and you need to go from absolute start. It’s a bit of time waste. 
Otherwise amazing app.
author: Pages Update

title: Worth the annual premium
content: Love this app- I have been able to discover so many new places using it over the last couple of years! Great for solo hikers too- just choose your hike, download the map and off you go!

No hint given of why to take the route, things to see, possible hazards if dog walking. Better just to buy a map and work out a route for yourself. Very disappointing.
author: DJWTA

title: Apple Watch maps removed
content: Used for the first time in a little while. They have (for some unknown reason) removed the map function on Apple Watch, rendering the app fairly useless as you now have to keep taking your phone out of your pocket rather than look at your watch to check for directions. A shame as the app is otherwise good but this omission has made me cancel my subscription.
